feature_contract.goal: Preserve exactly one clean world SkyGlow input for both stereo eyes across in-frame reduced-texture reconstruction so pause/ESC overlays can never be rebloomed from the rendered backbuffer.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the DX9Ex R30 stereo SkyGlow reduced-texture lifetime, pre-HUD source snapshot, and contaminated Present fallback; no generic scene sky policy, ESC geometry, DX11/DXVK or original game changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Direct source audit: R30ReleaseSkyGlowResources discarded GPU reducedSurface without clearing R30SkyGlowSceneCaptureEpoch; R30ApplyStereoSkyGlow checked the UI boundary before R30EnsureSkyGlowResources, which may recreate surfaces afterward.
trace_stages: Original game active glow flags and R33 source-owned HUD draw route into R30 pre-HUD capture.
R30 clean left/right StretchRect into reduced textures, then generation loss via SkyGlowFactor or recommended eye size updates.
R30 Present SkyGlow per-eye source selection must reject any post-HUD fallback after an invalidated same-frame capture.
subcomponents: Invalidate stale capture identity on reduced-texture destruction or resize.
Repeat UI-contamination fail-closed guard after resource allocation and test destructive mutations.

diagnosis.original_evidence: 2026-10-17 Quest3 report: sky follows the head and is optically doubled after renderer reorganization; only the isolated same-frame SkyGlow source-loss case is addressed here, not full sky geometry.
source_trace: Original SkyGlow original EXE flags are sampled by R30GameGlowActive.
R30CaptureSkyGlowSceneBeforeHud uses eyeSurface[2] and pre-HUD StretchRect into reducedSurface[2].
R30EnsureSkyGlowResources may release/recreate reduced textures during R30ApplyStereoSkyGlow following the earlier HUD boundary check.
diagnosis.root_cause: The same-frame valid capture epoch could outlive the D3D9 textures that actually held the clean world pixels, permitting a post-UI fallback or uninitialized reduced source.
alternatives_rejected: Never force a second dirty post-HUD StretchRect because it reintroduces ESC/UI and sky twice.
Do not change original game source or disable all SkyGlow as a workaround.
